title: Chopin Nocturne Op. 9 No. 1
spec: Docs/MOTIF-REDUCTION.md §15.2, N1–N5. MIDI only, 6/4: measure 0 is the 3/4 pickup, bar b ≥ 1 starts at beat 3 + 6(b − 1).
tuning: PeriodKappa 1.25 (§10 period DP; the spec's default is 1.0): with 1.0 the Nocturne's B takes five periods and N3 counts 10 level-2 prototypes; from 1.25 (or λ 0.75) four, while the étude's B keeps its five periods (E5) for every λ in {0.5, 0.75, 1} and κ in {0.75 … 2}. Every other parameter at its §10 default (Motifs/MotifSettings.cs); no song.json override
